propositions: The review-bot-ops runbook lacks the AWS instance id and region needed for operators to initiate SSM sessions, forcing them to guess values.
The prod instance id (i-00880b2c7f13527c5) and region (us-east-1) must be documented in the runbook with terraform source-of-truth citations (var.aws_region and versions.tf).
The runbook must include accurate SSM connect commands (start-session and send-command) and account id (896586841071) for operational reference.
The autodeploy.sh script body auto-updates via BOT_PATHS rsync during normal deploys, but script-only changes require hand-deployment because they do not trigger rsync.
The autodeploy installer and systemd unit files are excluded from in-run re-materialization and always require hand-deployment to avoid self-modification races.
